isolation.isolationMethod: Each test creates its own temp git repo — no shared state

VAL-WT-025.title: Copy files with include patterns
VAL-WT-025.evidence: go test ./internal/platform/worktree/... -v -count=1 -run TestCopyFiles_IncludePatterns → PASS (0.01s). CopyFiles with WithInclude("*.go", "*.mod") copies only matching files preserving directory structure.

VAL-WT-026.title: Copy files with exclude patterns
VAL-WT-026.evidence: go test ./internal/platform/worktree/... -v -count=1 -run TestCopyFiles_ExcludePatterns → PASS (0.01s). CopyFiles with WithExclude("*.test.ts", "node_modules/**") copies all except excluded.

VAL-WT-027.title: Copy combines include and exclude
VAL-WT-027.evidence: go test ./internal/platform/worktree/... -v -count=1 -run TestCopyFiles_CombinedIncludeExclude → PASS (0.00s). WithInclude("*.go") + WithExclude("*_test.go") copies Go files but skips test files.

VAL-WT-028.title: Copy handles .env dotfiles correctly
VAL-WT-028.evidence: go test ./internal/platform/worktree/... -v -count=1 -run TestCopyFiles_Dotfiles → PASS (0.01s). CopyFiles with .env* pattern copies .env, .env.local, .env.production.

VAL-WT-029.title: Copy preserves nested directory structure
VAL-WT-029.evidence: go test ./internal/platform/worktree/... -v -count=1 -run TestCopyFiles_PreservesNestedDirectoryStructure → PASS (0.01s). File at src/a/b/c/file.txt appears at dst/a/b/c/file.txt.

VAL-WT-030.title: PostCreate hook executes with correct env vars
VAL-WT-030.evidence: go test ./internal/platform/worktree/... -v -count=1 -run TestHooks_PostCreateEnvVars → PASS (0.80s). Hook receives WORKTREE_PATH, WORKTREE_BRANCH, WORKTREE_REPO_PATH, WORKTREE_COMMIT env vars.

VAL-WT-031.title: PostCreate hook failure does not roll back worktree
VAL-WT-031.evidence: go test ./internal/platform/worktree/... -v -count=1 -run TestHooks_PostCreateFailureDoesNotRollback → PASS (0.52s). Hook exits non-zero: worktree still exists on disk, Create returns wrapped error.

VAL-WT-032.title: PostRemove hook executes after removal
VAL-WT-032.evidence: go test ./internal/platform/worktree/... -v -count=1 -run TestHooks_PostRemoveExecutesAfterRemoval → PASS (0.60s). Hook runs after directory is gone, receives correct env vars.

VAL-WT-033.title: Hook timeout enforcement
VAL-WT-033.evidence: go test ./internal/platform/worktree/... -v -count=1 -run TestHooks_TimeoutEnforcement → PASS (1.39s). Hook exceeding timeout is killed; timeout error returned; underlying operation already completed.
